title: PhotographyRule
description: One entry of the rule database (docs/photography-rules.md §1). Markdown is normative for meaning; this JSON is normative for IDs, classes and threshold status.

blockingAllowed.description: Whether this rule may ever block readiness. Only FRAME_, measurable LIGHT_ and READY_ rules may.

source.description: Evidence class and reference, e.g. 'PRACTITIONER; research-sources.md §Headroom'.

firesWhen.description: Direction of the trigger: 'below' = the rule fires when the measurement is strictly less than `value`; 'above' = it fires when the measurement is strictly greater. Band rules (a comfortable range) are expressed as two thresholds, one per side.

exitValue.description: Hysteresis exit value (docs/guidance-engine.md §6.2). MUST lie on the non-firing side of `value`: > value when firesWhen = below, < value when firesWhen = above. Enforced by specs/validation/validate_specs.py.

suggestedActions.description: Candidate instruction ids this rule may propose, in stable order (the arbiter decides which one is shown). Every entry must be a valid GuidanceInstruction id AND be listed in this rule's allowedActions.

allowedActions.description: The subset of instruction ids this rule is allowed to emit, derived from docs/guidance-engine.md §5.4. Cross-checked against suggestedActions and the instruction id enum by specs/validation/validate_specs.py. Empty means the rule cannot drive guidance (it still produces a RuleResult).
